subject: Newsletter and Resident Procedural Guide
overview: The committee reviewed and approved a quarterly newsletter for publication and referred a new procedural guide for residents to the full City Council.

items.title: Resolution to publish a City Council newsletter
items.summary: Approved for publication the July–September 2024 City Council newsletter after refining descriptions of rodent control legislation and the charter review process.

items.title: Resolution to create a resident guide to City Council procedures
items.summary: Referred the draft procedural guide to the full City Council for approval, incorporating edits to define legislative terms and clarify that residents may use a sign-up sheet rather than standing in line to speak.
